pr_comments:
While the fix seems correct, the commit message and PR title is not.

The fix is to *ignore* disabled resource language addons on startup and to boot Kodi with the always available default language addon.

Commit message and PR title should be corrected accordingly.

issue_context.title: Kodi crashes on startup when Addons.db is removed and language pack is not default 'English'
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
### Describe the bug
When database file AddonsXY.db is removed prior to startup for any reason (testing, db-corruption etc.) and the installed and selected language pack addon is not the default `English` Kodi crashes.

The crash happens after the re-creating the database file.

## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
Kodi should recreate the missing Addons database and startup normally.

## Actual Behavior
db file is created but kodi crashes afterwards

### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. set your gui language to anything but english (for example german, has alse been reproduced with french)
2. remove your database file(s) AddonsXY.db from directory `.kodi/userdata/Database`
3. start kodi

### Debuglog
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
<!--- A debuglog is always mandatory when creating an issue. Provide one! -->
The debuglog can be found here:
https://paste.kodi.tv/jurobicoya.kodi

comments: Application fails to initialize because CLangInfo::SetLanguage returns false. The crash is not the cause, but fallout.
And this is the problem: Language resource addon can't be loaded (ofc, because we deleted Addons.db):
Ok, so just need to figure out why the DB is not initialised before this point. I guess when a fresh install initialises userdata would be a good starting point.
The DB is empty, no db file present. If you recreate the db (what will happen in this scenario), will it scan the addons folder and recreate information? I don't think so.
It does, but, all languages are disabled apart from english.  If I edit the db and enable it, Kodi will start.
Not sure what this code wants to achieve, but for our scenario the if block gets not executed, because the call to GetAddon succeeds because `false` means also to return not enabled addons.
I guess the fix is as simple as changing that `false`to `true` to get Kodi started with the default language, which is always available.

Yep, this will do the trick.
